dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, did you buy that new camera?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, dɪd juː ˈbaɪ ðæt ˈnuː ˈkæmərə?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No. I changed my mind. I don't have enough money.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ. aɪ ˈtʃeɪndʒd maɪ ˈmaɪnd. aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈhæv ɪˈnʌf ˈmʌni.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Twenty-five thousand baht. I can't afford a brand-new camera.
dialogue.reading: ˌtwɛnti ˈfaɪv ˈθaʊzənd ˈbɑːt. aɪ ˈkænt əˈfɔːrd ə ˌbrænd ˈnuː ˈkæmərə.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Why don't you buy a second-hand one?
dialogue.reading: ˈwaɪ ˈdoʊnt juː ˈbaɪ ə ˌsɛkənd ˈhænd ˈwʌn?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Good idea! But the store doesn't sell second-hand cameras.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd aɪˈdiːə! bʌt ðə ˈstɔːr ˈdʌzənt ˈsɛl ˌsɛkənd ˈhænd ˈkæmərəz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: My friend Jake sells them online. He has enough cameras to open a shop!
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈfrɛnd ˈdʒeɪk ˈsɛlz ðɛm ˌɑːnˈlaɪn. hiː ˈhæz ɪˈnʌf ˈkæmərəz tu ˈoʊpən ə ˈʃɑːp!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Great! Can I see his cameras this weekend?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt! kən aɪ ˈsiː hɪz ˈkæmərəz ðɪs ˈwiːkɛnd?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Sure. But hurry! His cameras are often out of stock.
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. bʌt ˈhɜːri! hɪz ˈkæmərəz ər ˈɔːfən ˈaʊt əv ˈstɑːk.
